hud-bstmy.5.1.design:
Files:
- crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/widget.rs:2663 start_transition (0 callers), WidgetAnimationState, animation branch :2690-2728, compute_transition_t :1660, interpolate_param :1677, :2673 `Instant::now()`
- transition_ms carried at protocol convert.rs:1482, 1508; session_server/verbs.rs:617; scene types.rs:2603; MCP widget publish path
- crates/tze_hud_widget/tests/gauge_interpolation.rs (1,157; fate decided here)

Evidence:
transition_ms is carried and stored but start_transition is never called, so animation code runs only in tests. Instant::now() breaks invariant 9 (injected time).

Approach:
Call start_transition from the widget publish/apply path with the scene/compositor clock; replace Instant::now() with the injected clock; ensure a running transition schedules wakes only until done (idle costs ~nothing); degraded mode snaps (inv 6). Move 3-4 interpolation/latest-wins tests from widget/tests/gauge_interpolation.rs into compositor widget.rs and delete the rest of that file.

Tests:
Add one test per param type (f32, color, enum snap) plus `degraded_mode_snaps_widget_transition` and `transition_stops_waking_after_completion`.

Expected delta: about -900 / +250

Every test named in docs/invariants.md is kept, or moved/renamed with docs/invariants.md updated in the same PR. Local builds on this host need `PROTOC=$HOME/.local/protoc/bin/protoc` (/usr/bin/protoc 3.12 fails on types.proto).

[decision] Widget transitions: wire them with an injected clock (vision: 'the runtime rasterizes and animates'). Keep transition_ms.

hud-bstmy.5.6.description:
Escalation (hard gate: amends invariant 3 wording, docs/invariants.md). One decision.

Facts: SharedState.freeze_active (protocol session.rs:191) is never set true outside tests (session_server tests.rs:2251). runtime shell/freeze.rs (1,137 lines) is referenced only by re-exports and 3 portal integration tests (text_stream_portal_{coalescing,cadence,governance} import FreezeQueue). The protocol freeze queue (session_server/freeze_queue.rs 217; mutations.rs:345-~420; mod.rs:413-426) can never fill. Invariant 3 currently covers safe mode and dismiss; freeze is described alongside.

Options:
A. Delete freeze (runtime shell/freeze.rs, protocol freeze queue, freeze_active) and reword invariant 3 to 'Safe mode and dismiss'. About -3,000 lines. Lands after T7 (hud-lirh2) retargets the portal tests.
B. Keep and wire it: a viewer chord/hotkey freezes agent mutations (queued, applied on unfreeze), drawn in chrome; add a behavior test. About +300 lines.
C. Status quo: leave dead code as is.

Recommendation: A. No current user, the POC Override criterion is satisfied by safe mode (hud-jm8nq.10), and 'prefer deleting over generalizing'. Consequences: A shrinks invariant 3 scope (no freeze promise); B adds a feature the vision does not require; C keeps 3k dead lines and a misleading invariant claim.

Default if unanswered: C (status quo, no code or invariant change).
